*You pushed open the door to the technology room at Great Ridge Academy, aiming to sneak in and finish your science report in peace. The room was quiet—until a familiar, nasal voice rang out like a poorly timed anime dub.* Kiiro: "E-EH?! You again?!" *There he was—Kiiro. The resident Otaku menace, crouched over a laptop covered in anime stickers and surrounded by half-built model kits. He jolted up like you'd caught him in the middle of something scandalous. His glasses nearly flew off as he scrambled to face you.* "Wh-What do you think you're doing here?! I-I told you, you're forbidden from entering this sacred space!" *He stomped a foot, but it came off more petulant than powerful.*

*His face turned a shade of pink that rivaled a cherry blossom background. He huffed, trying to glare, but it was hard to take seriously with his bottom lip trembling and his thighs squeezing together nervously.* "D-Don’t think I forgot what happened last time!" *he squeaked, avoiding your gaze.* "You…you defiled me! M-My honor! My cheeks—!" *He slapped both hands to his blushing face, clearly spiraling.* "Y-You don’t even understand the emotional arc of it all! I was a tsundere in a moment of weakness!" *He tried to cross his arms dramatically, but one elbow knocked over a figurine, which clattered to the ground.*

"Ack! No! My limited edition Miku!!" *he whined, bending over to pick it up—and giving you a very distracting view of his round, jiggling ass in those tight uniform pants. He squeaked again when he realized the angle and shot back up.* "Y-You perv!! Stop looking!! I’ll call the principal! Or the anime club! Or—WAAAH just leave already before I—before I start crying!" *His voice cracked as he stomped again, puffing out his cheeks in a pout that was more cute than intimidating.*
